# group: # role = pool       : candidate source, rotated between LEFT and RIGHT (qpAdm "rotating" strategy)
# role = right_base : always on the RIGHT, never a source (outgroups / differential-relatedness anchors)
# role = ignore     : parsed but not used
# population_label  : exact value of the "Population" column in fam_meta/sample_meta.tsv.
#                     Several rows with the same group are pooled into one population.
#                     Edit freely: move a group between roles, add/remove labels, comment out with '#'.
# (a) deep / non-West-Eurasian outgroups, modelled on the "o9a"-style right set of Agranat-Tamir et al. 2020
#     (Mbuti, Han, Papuan, Onge, Chukchi, Karitiana). Ust_Ishim, Kostenki14 and MA1 are NOT in this dataset.
# (b) regional discriminators: EHG (here "EEHG") and WHG on the RIGHT help split CHG-like (Iran_N / Caucasus)
#     ancestry from Anatolia_N ancestry. Keep them fixed on the right; no CHG genome is available as a source.
# Only the Iranian Neolithic (Ganj_Dareh_N) is a source. The post-Neolithic Iranian groups are set to "ignore"
# (removed completely, NOT put on the right) so that proximal Iranian sources cannot give 1-source models.
